# Slice B canonical manifest v1 and framing tests

This commit provides only a pure bytes parser and tests. It does not enable the production broker, compile target C, construct a VM image, or accredit isolation. Production still returns `probe_unavailable`.

## Frozen canonical manifest (`SBM1`)

Binary byte string, no JSON, newline, padding, BOM or UTF-8 normalization. Exact order and offsets, all unsigned integers network/big-endian, SHA-256 raw 32-byte digests (not 64-character ASCII hex):

| Offset | Width | Field | Rule |
|---:|---:|---|---|
| 0 | 4 | magic | literal ASCII `SBM1` |
| 4 | 2 | total manifest length | u16, counts all bytes including trailing digest, exactly `260 + path_len` |
| 6 | 2 | path_len | u16, 1..511 |
| 8 | path_len | path | ASCII POSIX relative path, `/` only separator; no leading `/`, empty/dot/dotdot components, backslash, control, DEL, NUL or bytes >0x7e; compare raw bytes to the approved candidate path |
| 8+P | 32 | contract_sha256 | decode exactly 64 lowercase hex digits from validated contract identity |
| 40+P | 32 | workspace_sha256 | decode exactly 64 lowercase hex digits from complete checked snapshot identity |
| 72+P | 32 | before_sha256 | decode exactly 64 lowercase hex digits from selected candidate record, rehash original snapshot bytes |
| 104+P | 32 | after_sha256 | decode exactly 64 lowercase hex digits from selected candidate record; independently rehash candidate C bytes |
| 136+P | 4 | source_len | u32, 1..65536, equal raw candidate C byte length and SBI1 payload length |
| 140+P | 32 | source_sha256 | SHA-256 of candidate C bytes, must equal after_sha256 and SBI1 digest |
| 172+P | 4 | goal_len | u32, 0..127, equal validated goal byte length (empty permitted) |
| 176+P | 32 | goal_sha256 | SHA-256 of validated goal bytes; no goal bytes go to guest |
| 208+P | 4 | timeout_ms | u32, exactly 5000 for this version; not the only host deadline |
| 212+P | 16 | nonce | fresh host-generated 128-bit random bytes, reject all-zero and replay within broker invocation; not authorization/authentication |
| 228+P | 32 | manifest_sha256 | SHA-256 of byte offsets 0 through 227+P inclusive, including declared total length |

Maximum exact length is 771 bytes (`260+511`), fixed cap 771 prior to allocation; minimum 261. No ignored bytes or unknown fields. A decoder receives the entire bounded byte string and separately trusted expected contract/snapshot/candidate/source/goal/nonce context; digest verification alone does not authenticate values. Compare all context values byte-for-byte and refuse mismatches before any VM creation. Nonce uniqueness lives at invocation boundary, not a process-global durable anti-replay promise. Paths remain bounded by the live snapshot limit. SBI1 and SBO1 stay as commit-1 docs specify; request source and manifest are independently digested but must cross-bind. No shell interpolation.

Fixture below uses path `main.c`, source bytes `b'#include <stdio.h>\nint main(void){puts("OK");return 0;}\n'`, goal bytes `b'OK\n'`, timeout 5000, nonce hex `000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f`. Other digest inputs: contract `b'contract fixture'`, workspace `b'workspace fixture'`, before `b'before fixture'`; after/source SHA-256 of the source shown, goal SHA-256 of the goal shown. This is parser fixture context only, not a genuine contract or approved candidate. Generated values: source_len 56, goal_len 3, total 266, SHA256(full manifest) 623380acdc4ba465703ada3c0b29e127a5d6de8f62da9ab19332615d0e88ff5c, SHA256(manifest body) 553f44f653360f7c08facc055f383f8aa1b7549a31ee1ac8dae7f74e1301b5fd.

| Vector | Exact full bytes (hex) | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| `valid` | `` | accept parser and bound context only |
| `changed_path` | `` | digest refusal |
| `truncated` | `` | length/truncated refusal |
| `trailing` | `` | length/trailing refusal |
| `too_long_declared` | `` | length_limit refusal before allocation |
| `bad_magic` | `` | magic refusal |
| `zero_nonce` | `` | nonce refusal (checked before digest; rehashed mutation also refuses nonce) |

Additional mutations against `valid`: replace total length at offsets 4..5 with `0000` => `trailing` (declared length shorter than supplied frame); path_len offsets 6..7 with `0000` => `path_length`; source_len offsets `136+P..139+P` with `00010001` => `source_limit`; goal_len offsets `172+P..175+P` with `00000080` => `goal_limit`; timeout offsets `208+P..211+P` with `00000001` => `timeout`; replace byte 0 with `00` => `magic`. Recompute trailing digest on each structurally valid mutation when testing field-specific refusal, otherwise it may fail at digest first. Test one-byte byte-for-byte mismatches against trusted context for every hash, path, length and nonce. Refusal never produces `observed_match`.

## Parser and test shape

The concrete test lives at `tests/test_typed_c_framing.py`, registered as a CTest case in `CMakeLists.txt` so the common `ctest` steps on Linux and Windows discover it. Use Python 3 standard library (existing v2 gate is Python): `tools/typed_c_contract/framing.py` with pure `encode_manifest`, `decode_manifest`, `encode_source_frame`, `decode_source_frame`, `decode_result_frame` operating only on `bytes`; narrow typed records or dictionaries for parsed values and a closed `FrameRefusal(code)` for malformed wire. Explicit `memoryview`/`int.from_bytes` cursor and exact-buffer-length checks, no slicing to unbounded declared length, no permissive JSON. No QEMU launch or broker wiring from these pure functions. Tests in `tests/test_typed_c_framing.py`, loading verbatim hex constants from commit-1 design and the frozen manifest table; assert exact decode, exact encode equality, all listed negative mutations, valid hash but wrong bound-context refusal, empty stdout distinct from `OK` and `OK\n`, NUL/CRLF preserved, and no logging raw payload. CI invokes these tests on Linux/Windows. SBI1 `source_min` is a parser-only fixture, not a source-eligibility assertion. Stream reader later must cap before allocation and reject trailing bytes/second frame; in-memory parser only validates a supplied bounded buffer. Pure parser tests establish framing, not isolation.

## Scope of this commit

Only canonical manifest docs, pure standard-library parser and fixtures. The pinned image recipe and VM work remain later separately reviewed commits; no image or external artifacts are included here. The parser digest detects corruption, not hostile supervisor forgery or source authorization. The host must enforce stream caps and context binding before VM creation in later code; no runtime call uses this module yet.
